text:
elena_pm: Quick sync — proposed rollout for `routing-fallback-v2`.
elena_pm: TL;DR: staged regional ramp + small canary, automated fallback to baseline model, feature-flag handshake for Dedicated/Private customers.
elena_pm: Goals: protect latency SLOs, limit quality regressions, verify cost profile before broad ramp.
raj_sre: Sounds good. What are the canary windows and metrics to watch? :eyes:
marta_eng: Proposed sequence below (short). Canaries per region, then account-level A/B for key customers.
marta_eng: ```
flag: routing_fallback_v2
stages:
  - id: canary-us-west
    traffic: 1%
    duration: 2h
  - id: ramp-1
    traffic: 10%
    duration: 4h
  - id: ramp-2
    traffic: 50%
    duration: 24h
  - id: global
    traffic: 100%
    duration: 48h
fallbacks:
  - id: baseline-llama
    trigger: latency_p95>400ms OR error_rate>0.4% OR cost_per_token_increase>15%
    action: route-to:baseline-llama
    notify: #incidents, @raj_sre
```
marta_eng: We'll also enable prefix-level KV cache warmup during canary to avoid cold-start noise.
raj_sre: OK. For alerts: p95 latency >400ms sustained for 5m -> Pager, error_rate spike >0.4% for 3m -> Pager, quality regression (eval suite) >2% -> Pager + rollback.
sam_product: Add a business metric check: user-reported regression via feedback form spike >1.5x baseline within 24h -> hold rollout.
elena_pm: Launch criteria checklist (must pass all):
elena_pm: 1) Canary p95 latency within +20% of baseline and <400ms
elena_pm: 2) Error rate <= baseline +0.2%
elena_pm: 3) Cost delta per-token <= 15% (opt-in threshold)
elena_pm: 4) Eval regression on core prompt set <1.5%
elena_pm: 5) Observability dashboards live + runbook updated
raj_sre: Runbook changes: add explicit kill-switch and step-by-step fallback (we should include sample `curl` to flip flag).
raj_sre: Example toggle command:
raj_sre: ```bash
# enable canary
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"routing_fallback_v2","state":"on","scope":"canary-us-west"}' \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/feature-flags
```
marta_eng: Also add automated rollback policy in control plane: if p95>400ms for 3 consecutive windows OR eval regression >2% -> auto-disable flag and route to baseline.
sam_product: For Dedicated/private customers: add opt-in rollout via tenant flag and manual approval; cannot auto-rollback without customer consent for on-prem.
elena_pm: Staged regions order (min-risk): us-west -> us-east -> eu-west -> ap-southeast. Each region needs separate canary window.
elena_pm: A/B test notes: for a subset of enterprise customers we should run 50/50 feature vs baseline for 24-72h and collect eval prompts + cost telemetry.
raj_sre: Telemetry to wire up before canary: latency p50/p95/p99, cpu/gpu util, error_rate, token_cost, request_size histogram, kernel-fallback count, model-switch count.
marta_eng: Dashboards: per-region time series + per-customer breakdown and a single global "rollout health" score (0-100) computed from weighted signals.
elena_pm: Communication plan: pre-announce in #product 24h before canary, notify affected customers, update status page if broader ramp needed.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 1778124000 — Will post status updates.
sam_product: Action items:
  - @marta_eng: push control-plane flag + auto-rollback policy (today EOD)
  - @raj_sre: add/verify dashboards and alert rules (tomorrow morning)
  - @elena_pm: coordinate customer opt-ins and comms (today)
  - @marta_eng + @raj_sre: dry-run toggle in staging (ASAP)
elena_pm: Approvals: @marta_eng and @raj_sre please ack when ready. If no objections by 10:00 PT tomorrow, we'll start canary window.
marta_eng: ACK
raj_sre: ACK
elena_pm: cool — I'll draft the status update and runbook edits after staging dry-run. :thumbsup:
